root_cause.text: `io_wq_remove_pending()` fails to verify whether a predecessor work item is hashed before comparing its hash value, allowing a non-hashed predecessor to spuriously match hash bucket 0 and be stored in `wq->hash_tail[0]`, which eventually becomes a dangling pointer when the predecessor is freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds the `io_wq_is_hashed(prev_work)` check to `io_wq_remove_pending()` before assigning `wq->hash_tail[hash] = prev_work`:

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a safety check to ensure the previous work item is hashed before updating the hash tail in io_wq_remove_pending.
intent_record.what: Added a check `io_wq_is_hashed(prev_work)` to the conditional statement before updating `wq->hash_tail[hash]`.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the previous work item is actually hashed before retrieving its hash value, preventing incorrect hash tail updates with non-hashed work items.

candidates.rationale: This statement checks if the predecessor work item (prev_work) has the same hash, but fails to verify if prev_work is actually hashed (using io_wq_is_hashed(prev_work)). If prev_work is not hashed, io_get_work_hash(prev_work) might return 0, spuriously matching hash bucket 0 and setting wq->hash_tail[0] to a non-hashed work item.
